title: Management meeting - Work Regulations update (AI summary)
body:
Meeting summary (auto-generated)
Attendees: Laura De Smet, Sophie Claes, Marc Dubois (SD Worx, joined remotely)

The meeting focused on the SD Worx bulletin about sick leave certificates. Laura noted that requiring a doctor's visit for a single day of illness creates unnecessary burden for employees and doctors. Sophie agreed and said that sick leave abuse has not been an issue at Foo.

Decision: Foo will NOT opt out. The first-day exemption will be adopted (maximum 3 times per calendar year).

Action items
- Marc (SD Worx) drafts amendment no. 3 to Article 7.3 of the Work Regulations.
- Laura signs the amendment together with the employee representatives.
- Sophie updates the absence form in the employee portal.
